basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 7 Office Helper, Project Technical Support and More Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical), Project Technical Support-III, Project Officer, Office Helper
basic_details.short_information: AIIMS Bhopal is filling 7 project posts for a One Health zoonotic disease surveillance project. Five posts are at AIIMS Bhopal and two are at Van Vihar National Park Zoo, Bhopal. There is no application form to post and no fee. Candidates go to the Department of Microbiology for a walk-in interview or a walk-in written test on 18 November 2026 or 19 November 2026, depending on the post. The posts include an Office Helper post open to 10th pass candidates, and a Project Research Scientist-I post that pays Rs. 56000 plus 20% HRA.

application_fee.details: There is no application fee (Nil) for any post.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bhopal
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhopal is in Saket Nagar, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. Its letterhead describes it as an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of India. These posts are in its Department of Microbiology. They serve the PM-ABHIM funded research project "Establishing a One Health Sentinel Surveillance System in High Human-Animal Interaction Settings among Selected Zoos in India". The notice's heading calls it an ICMR funded zoonotic research project.

content_sections.heading: About the Zoonotic Research Project
content_sections.text: The project will set up a One Health surveillance system to detect and monitor zoonotic diseases early, where humans, animals and the environment meet in selected Indian zoos. The work covers: human syndromic surveillance animal pathogen screening environmental monitoring vector surveillance molecular diagnostics serology metagenomics genomic epidemiology The aim is to assess and reduce the risk of zoonotic disease. The engagement is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: There is no application fee (Nil) for any post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by walk-in interview or walk-in written test, as shown in the dates table above. Candidates report to the Principal Investigator at the selection venue: Department of Microbiology, Ground Floor, Medical College Building, AIIMS Bhopal, Saket Nagar, Bhopal - 462020, Madhya Pradesh. Being allowed to sit the selection process does not confirm a candidate's eligibility. A selected candidate can still be disqualified at document verification if the essential criteria are not met. The competent authority's decision on selection is final.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Period: The offer is for one year at first. It may be extended depending on performance and continued funding for the project. Nature of the job: The posts are purely on contract. They give no right to a regular appointment, or to permanent absorption in AIIMS Bhopal or ICMR/DHR. End of contract: The contract expires automatically at the end of its period unless both sides agree to renew it. Either side can end it at any time with 30 days' notice or salary in lieu of notice. ICMR recruitment: The post continues only as long as the vacancy is not filled through ICMR's central recruitment examination. Posting: Staff can be posted anywhere the project needs them, including rural areas and field sites. Leave: Leave follows ICMR's leave policy for extramural research projects. Accommodation: The Institute does not provide a hostel or any other accommodation. Private practice: Private practice of any kind is not allowed. Conduct: Staff must follow the Institute's rules of conduct and discipline.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in for the Office Helper post?
faq.answer: Office Helper candidates report at 09:00 am on Thursday, 19 November 2026. They take a walk-in written test.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is needed for Office Helper?
faq.answer: You need a High school (10th grade) pass or equivalent from a recognized board, and up to 2 years of relevant experience. The upper age limit is 28 years.

faq.question: Q3. Where will the Project Officer work?
faq.answer: The single Project Officer post is for Van Vihar National Park Zoo, Bhopal. It pays Rs. 30600 (consolidated) and needs at least 5 years' experience in Accounts / Finance / Administration work.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an interview or a written test for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in written test, held on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, from 09:00 am. The pay is Rs. 28000 plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Can engineering graduates apply for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: Yes. A four-year Graduate Degree in Engineering / IT / CS is accepted as an alternative to a Post Graduate Degree in the relevant subject.

faq.question: Q6. On what date is age counted?
faq.answer: Age, qualification and experience are all checked on the date of the walk-in interview or walk-in written test for your post.

faq.question: Q7. How long will the job last?
faq.answer: The offer is for one year at first. It can be extended depending on performance and the project's funding. Either side can end the contract with 30 days' notice.

faq.question: Q8. I am a government employee. What extra document do I need?
faq.answer: Bring a No Objection Certificate from your current employer to the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. Will AIIMS Bhopal pay travel costs or give accommodation?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA is paid for attending the selection or for joining, and the Institute provides no hostel or other accommodation.
